---
name: Bug report
about: Report a reproducible product problem.
---

For vulnerabilities, use [SECURITY.md](../../SECURITY.md) instead. Do not include credentials, private data, or raw service responses.

## Versions and environment

Package version, host name and version, Node.js version, and OS if relevant.
Do not include your real name, email, service URL, or personal configuration.

## Steps to reproduce

Describe the smallest sequence that reproduces the problem.

## Expected behavior

Describe what you expected to happen.

## Actual behavior

Describe what happened, including sanitized errors and relevant limits or skips.

## Sanitized reproduction

Provide a minimal example using synthetic or sanitized data.
